headline: Norway Sovereign Wealth Fund Loses $30 Billion in Third Quarter on Rate Hike Hit
summary: Norway's sovereign wealth fund, the world's largest, suffered a loss of $30 billion in the third quarter as rising interest rates impacted global asset valuations.
why: As a massive global investor holding stakes in thousands of companies, the fund's performance illustrates the broad valuation impact of rising benchmark interest rates across global equities and fixed income.

impacts.name: Global Equities
impacts.why: Higher discount rates reduce the present value of future corporate cash flows, dragging down portfolio valuations.
